name: Order of Malta
officialName: Sovereign Military Hospitaller Order of Saint John of Jerusalem, of Rhodes and of Malta

flag.description: A red field with a white cross whose arms run to the edges, centered on the flag.
flag.symbolism: The white cross on red has been the Order's emblem since the Middle Ages and recalls its origins as a crusader-era hospital order.

hook: The Order of Malta is a plain white cross dead center on red, running to every edge; Denmark pushes its cross towards the pole and Switzerland keeps its cross short on a square.
trivia: The Order was founded in Jerusalem around 1099 and later ruled Rhodes and then Malta, until Napoleon took the island in 1798.
Its headquarters, Palazzo Malta on Rome's Via Condotti, has extraterritorial status in Italy.
